BrochureContent.Content:
A modern 4 bedroom, 4-bathroom detached home c. 235 square meters in this exclusive 5 house development with beautiful views of the town and the Galtee Mountains. 
This home offers a rare level of privacy without compromising on convenience with Primary and Secondary Schools directly opposite the road and it is just a short stroll to the Main Street and all other amenities.

Ground Floor:

Entrance Hall:   
Large entrance with cream tiled flooring, power points, radiator, carpet on stairs with patio doors on landing 
to balcony.

Livingroom / Sunroom:  9.6 m x 4.5 m. 
Ample bright room with stove, solid timber flooring, radiator, power points, double French doors to hallway. 

Conservatory:  4.6 m x 3 m. 
Cream tiled flooring, power points, radiator, door to hallway.

Kitchen-cum-Diningroom:  4.2 m x 9 m. 
Two doors to hallway to include double French doors, cream split level kitchen units, built-in oven and 
microwave, tiled flooring, power points, radiator, door to utility.

Utility:  1.7 m x 4 m. 
Split level cream units, cream tile flooring, radiator, power points, door to garage and back door.

Downstairs Toilet:  1.4 m x 2.6 m.
Toilet, WHB, widow, radiator, fully tiled.

1st Floor:

Bedroom 1 / Master Bedroom:   5.1 m x 4 m.
Beautiful bright airy bedroom with carpet flooring, radiator, power points, with walk-in wardrobe and En-suite.
En-suite: shower, toilet, WHB, radiator, window.
This bedroom has patio doors to balcony.

Bedroom 2:   4.2 m x 4.1 m. 
With built-in wardrobes, carpet flooring, radiator, power points, window.

Bedroom 3:   3.3 m x 5.7 m. 
Carpet flooring, radiator, power points, window.

Bathroom:  2.6 m x 3 m. 
Free standing bath, separate shower, toilet, WHB, radiator, fully tiled, window.

Bedroom 4:   3.8 m x 4.5 m. 
Large window, carpet flooring, power points, vent, with en-suite shower.
En-suite:  Shower, toilet, WHB, radiator, fully tiled.

Attached Garage:  4 m x 5.4 m.
